changeBaseRate(uint256,uint48,bool).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin or em_manager role         - There is an underflow or overflow on adjustments

params.add: bool determining addition or subtraction to baseEmissionRate
params.changeBy_: uint256 added or subtracted from baseEmissionRate
params.forNumBeats_: uint256 number of times to change baseEmissionRate by changeBy_

createPendingBondMarket().details: Notes:         - If there is no pending capacity, no bond market will be created         This function will revert if:         - The caller is not this contract, or an address with the admin/manager role         - The contract is disabled         - The bond market cannot be created

disable(bytes).details: This function performs the following steps:         1. Validates that the caller has the admin or emergency role         2. Validates that the contract is enabled         3. Calls the implementation-specific `_disable()` function         4. Changes the state of the contract to disabled         5. Emits the `Disabled` event

params.disableData_: The data to pass to the implementation-specific `_disable()` function

enable(bytes).details: This function performs the following steps:         1. Validates that the caller has the admin role         2. Validates that the contract is disabled         3. Calls the implementation-specific `_enable()` function         4. Changes the state of the contract to enabled         5. Emits the `Enabled` event

params.enableData_: The data to pass to the implementation-specific `_enable()` function

execute().details: This function performs the following:             - Adjusts the beat counter             - Exits if the beat counter is not 0             - Sets the parameters for the auction             - If the auction tracking period has finished and there is a deficit of OHM sold, attempts to create a bond market             - If market creation fails (external dependency), emits BondMarketCreationFailed and continues execution             Notes:             - If the CD auction is not running (e.g. the auctioneer contract is disabled), this function will consider OHM to have been under-sold across the auction tracking period. This will result in a bond market being created at the end of the auction tracking period in an attempt to sell the remaining OHM.             - If there are delays in the heartbeat (which calls this function), auction result tracking will be affected.

getMinPriceFor(uint256).details: Expects `price` to already be expressed in the reserve asset's decimal scale.         This function does not adjust/convert decimal scales.

params.price: Price of OHM in reserve token terms, scaled to the reserve asset's decimals

getSizeFor(uint256).details: Returns the standard tick size if the target emission is at least the standard tick size.         Otherwise, 0 is returned to indicate that the auction should be disabled.

returns.permissions: - Array of keycodes and function selectors for requested permissions.

rescue(address).details: This function is restricted to the ADMIN role

params.token_: The address of the ERC20 token to rescue

restart().details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin role         - The restart timeframe has passed since shutdown

setBacking(uint256).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin role         - newBacking is 0         - newBacking is less than 90% of current backing (to prevent large sudden drops)         Note: if adjustment is more than 33% down, contract should be redeployed

params.newBacking: to adjust to TODO maybe put in a timespan arg so it can be smoothed over time if desirable

setBondContracts(address,address).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin role         - bondAuctioneer_ is the zero address         - teller_ is the zero address

params.bondAuctioneer_: address of the bond auctioneer contract
params.teller_: address of the bond teller contract

setBondMarketCapacityScalar(uint256).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin or em_manager role         - newScalar is greater than MAX_BOND_MARKET_CAPACITY_SCALAR (200%)

setCDAuctionContract(address).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin role         - cdAuctioneer_ is the zero address         - The deposit asset of the CDAuctioneer is not the same as the reserve asset in this contract

params.cdAuctioneer_: address of the cd auctioneer contract

setMinPriceScalar(uint256).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin or em_manager role         - newScalar is less than ONE_HUNDRED_PERCENT (100% in 18 decimals)

setMinimumPremium(uint256).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin or em_manager role         - newMinimumPremium_ is 0

params.newMinimumPremium_: The new minimum premium, in terms of ONE_HUNDRED_PERCENT

setRestartTimeframe(uint48).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin role         - newTimeframe is 0

setTickSize(uint256).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin or em_manager role         - newTickSize_ is 0

params.newTickSize_: as a fixed amount in OHM decimals (9)

setVestingPeriod(uint48).details: This function reverts if:         - The caller does not have the admin role         - newVestingPeriod_ is more than 31536000 (1 year in seconds)

bondMarketCapacityScalar.details: The value must be between 0 and MAX_BOND_MARKET_CAPACITY_SCALAR (0-200%)

minPriceScalar.details: The value must be greater than or equal to ONE_HUNDRED_PERCENT (100%)

minimumPremium.details: A minimum premium of 1e18 would require the market price to be 100% above the backing price (i.e. double).

vestingPeriod.details: Initialized at 0, which means no vesting.
